messages:
Alex: Heads-up — starting a staggered rollout in the 02:00 UTC change window. Components: runtime v2.14, api v1.8.3, router-shim 0.9.1, console schema v4.2. Need cross-service handshake sequence + explicit rollback criteria.
Priya: Recommended order? I'd prefer router -> runtime -> api -> console to avoid traffic landing on incompatible runtimes.
Mateo: Agree, router first to steer traffic to fallback pool, then runtime so new kernels land behind routing. API and console last.
Jing: Two callouts: 1) runtime v2.14 changes KV-cache eviction semantics (minor) — if not matched by router shim 0.9.1 we can see cache misses + p95 blip. 2) console schema v4.2 is read-only compatible but migration needs feature flag.
Alex: Good points. Plan: 
- Step A: deploy router-shim 0.9.1 as a canary to 5% in us/eu with pinned fallback available
- Step B: deploy runtime v2.14 to canary pool, run canary perf/regen tests
- Step C: shift 25% traffic to new runtime via router rules, observe 30m
- Step D: deploy api v1.8.3 behind feature flag, run smoke
- Step E: deploy console schema v4.2 and flip feature flag after OK
Priya: Can we add a short rollback window after each step? say 30m strong guard. If any step breaches SLOs we rollback that component only.
Mateo: Rollback triggers I propose: error_rate_increase >= 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase >= 40% vs baseline for 5m OR user-facing errors on key endpoints (create/chat/embed). Also CPU/GPU OOM observed.
Jing: Add regression on quality: generating failure rate >1% for the generation job suite (run nightly quickset) — will monitor via canary evals.
Alex: Who's watching metrics? @Jing on infra alerts, @Priya on runtime logs, @Mateo on routing. I'll coordinate rollback execution.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot has queued runs: 
- router-shim/0.9.1 -> canary (5%)
- runtime/2.14 -> canary group 'canary-1'
- api/1.8.3 -> staged
Use /deploy start <component> to begin. See run id: RB-20260320-438
ops-bot: preflight checks: kube clusters healthy, registry image available, infra quotas ok, certs valid.
Priya: Quick preflight checklist snippet I ran:
```
kubectl get nodes --context=prod-us | grep Ready
docker pull registry.redwood/runtime:2.14
curl -sS https://status.example/infra | jq .ok
```
Mateo: Routing rule example we'll use to shift traffic (router config):
```
route {
  match: { header: "x-release-canary" }
  weight: 5
  fallback: previous-runtime
}
```
Alex: Release notes (short): runtime 2.14 — KV eviction optimization, faster attention kernel, small behavioral tweak in prefix caching; API 1.8.3 — new /v1/chat param for tool hints; router 0.9.1 — shim to support new KV header; console 4.2 — schema for route debug logs. Add known compatibility note about KV eviction.
Jing: Monitoring knobs: p95 latency, error-rate, canary-eval-quality (generation-fails), gpu-mem-usage. I'll create a dashboard link and set 3 alert levels (warn/critical/auto-snooze).
Priya: If rollback needed, order to rollback: reverse of deploy order, but router rollback has to be last because it must ensure traffic falls back to previous runtime. So if runtime fails, rollback runtime first; if router introduces routing issues, rollback router.
Alex: Good — document exact commands in runbook. Example quick rollback commands:
```
deploy-bot rollback runtime 2.14 --run RB-20260320-438
deploy-bot rollback router-shim 0.9.1
kubectl rollout undo deploy/runtime --to-revision=2.13
```
Mateo: Also ensure we don't auto-scale down canary pool until after 2h stabilization. Manual guard.
ops-bot: Locking change window 2026-03-20T02:00Z -> 2026-03-20T05:00Z. Quiet window engaged. Notifications to oncall sent.
Alex: Assignments: Priya = runtime lead, Mateo = routing lead, Jing = observability lead, Alex = release lead. I'll update release notes and the PR with exact image tags.
Priya: I'll start router canary at 02:05 UTC and tag watchers. Will ping here when each step completes.
Mateo: I'll have rollback commands prepared in ops vault and a small playbook.
Jing: Dashboard and canary-eval link: https://metrics.redwood/canary/RB-20260320-438 (will post live once configured)
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: router-shim/0.9.1 canary scheduled by @Priya at 1716260400
Alex: Thanks team. If anyone sees anything odd after router canary, call rollback immediately and annotate incident. :white_check_mark:
